index.title: EternalMonitor: your iPad as a second screen for your Windows PC
index.description: Mirror your Windows PC or add the iPad as a real second screen, over USB or Wi-Fi. Apple Pencil, touch and keyboard go back to the PC. Free and open source.

mac.line: <0/>Mac support is <1>coming soon</1>, for iPad and iPhone Duo. Until then, EternalMonitor streams from Windows PCs, and Apple's <2>Sidecar</2> works with an iPad.

index.hero.title: Your Windows PC, on your iPad.
index.hero.lead: Mirror it, extend it, draw on it with Apple Pencil.

index.films.title: Watch it work.
index.film.secondScreen.label: Film: in the Windows app, the pointer picks Second screen. The iPad in front of the monitor stops mirroring and becomes a second display, and a reference sheet of night paintings is dragged off the monitor onto it, where it stays.
index.film.secondScreen.title: Extend your desktop
index.film.pair.label: Film: in the Windows app, the pointer clicks QR code and the Scan to connect dialog opens. On the iPad, a finger taps Scan QR code, the camera finds the code on the PC's screen, and the iPad starts showing the PC while the Windows app says it is streaming to the iPad Pro over Wi-Fi.
index.film.pair.title: Pair with a QR code
index.film.fit.label: Film: the iPad app shows a PC picture with bars above and below, a finger taps the picture button and it fills the screen, then fits again.
index.film.fit.title: Fit or fill the iPad
index.film.performance.label: Film: the Windows app's Performance page on three PCs in turn, one with an NVIDIA, one with an AMD and one with an Intel graphics card, each encoding its own stream.
index.film.performance.title: Your graphics card does the work
index.film.pencil.label: Film: the iPad app shows the PC's painting full screen. An Apple Pencil paints blades of grass that swell where it presses and thin where it lifts, then tilts over to shade moonlight on the water.
index.film.pencil.title: Apple Pencil, with pressure and tilt
index.film.feedback.label: Film: in the Windows app, Send feedback opens a panel, Something I like is picked and a short note is typed, then Open in my email app is clicked and the app says the email app should open with the message ready.
index.film.feedback.title: Send feedback from the app

index.faq.title: Before you install
index.faq.free.a: Yes. Free, open source under MIT, with no account.
index.faq.mac.q: Does it work with a Mac?
index.faq.mac.answer: Not yet. Mac support is <0>coming soon</0>, for iPad and iPhone Duo; Apple's Sidecar doesn't work with an iPhone Duo. Until then, use <1>Sidecar</1> with an iPad.
index.faq.usb.a: Wi-Fi to start. A cable gives a steadier picture and charges the iPad; it needs Apple's free Apple Devices app open on the PC (Windows 10 22H2 or 11).
index.faq.encrypted.a: Not yet. Pairing keeps other devices out, so use a network you trust. Over a cable, the stream stays on the cable.
index.faq.ipads.a: An iPad with iPadOS 17 or later. Apple Pencil (USB-C) has no pressure sensor, so its strokes keep one width.
index.faq.data.q: Does it send anything to you?
index.faq.data.a: Yes, diagnostics while the apps run: device details, errors and stream stats, including PC and iPad names, audio device names and network addresses. Never your screen, audio or pairing codes. Kept up to 30 days, sometimes less, and up to 7 more days in backups. Turn it off in Settings. <0>Details</0>.
index.faq.broken.a: See <0>known issues</0> and the <1>setup guide</1>, or <2>tell us</2>.
